page: Google Cloud Platform t2a-standard-1 is an entry-level general-purpose virtual machine based on the ARM64 architecture, powered by an Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor. The instance provides 1 dedicated physical core mapping to 1 vCPU running at a fixed 3.0 GHz clock frequency, coupled with 4.0 GB of system memory. Cache hierarchy includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache, with hardware-level support for AES encryption. The instance provisions zero local storage and no GPUs, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operational storage needs.

Benchmark data reflects the architectural profile of a single dedicated ARM core. The server achieves an average single-core score of 1783.48 in stress-ng and 1018.0 in Geekbench. Because the server contains only a single execution thread, multi-core metrics match single-core values, resulting in low aggregate multi-threaded compute percentiles. Memory bandwidth yields 11.99 GB/sec for large unbuffered reads and 7.95 GB/sec for writes, scaling to 70.86 GB/sec for small cached blocks. At the application layer, the instance handles 1.27 million Redis SET operations per second and 1.38 GB/sec in static web throughput.

With its 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, t2a-standard-1 provides cost-effective, dedicated execution without the resource throttling typical of burstable instances. The limited core count and absence of local disks constrain throughput for multi-threaded services, data-intensive pipelines, or high-concurrency databases. The profile is appropriately matched to small microservices, ARM software compilation and testing, lightweight API routing, low-traffic web serving, and peripheral background utilities.
description: Google Cloud Platform t2a-standard-1 is an entry-level general-purpose instance built on the 64-bit ARM architecture. It is powered by an Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.0 GHz, configured with 1 physical core, 1 dedicated vCPU, and 4.0 GB of memory. The CPU cache architecture includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, alongside hardware AES cryptography support. The server includes no local storage or GPUs, relying on external disk attachments. Benchmark performance reflects its single-core footprint: stress-ng single-core performance registers average throughput at 1783.48, while multi-core metrics sit in the lowest decile. Memory bandwidth yields 11.99 GB/sec read and 7.95 GB/sec write on large blocks. Delivering modest resource density and non-burstable dedicated execution, t2a-standard-1 is tailored for lightweight ARM microservices, dev/test environments, basic web serving, and background task processing.
